casebody.head_matter:
CGI TECHNOLOGIES AND SOLUTIONS, INC., petitioner,
v.
Rhonda ROSE, et al.
No. 12-240.
Supreme Court of the United States
April 22, 2013.
On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit for further consideration in light of US Airways, Inc. v. McCutchen, 569 U.S. ----, 133 S.Ct. 1537, 185 L.Ed.2d 654 (2013).
